core: transcriptional commitment of myeloid progenitors to the granulocyte lineage
qualifier: with suppression of monocyte and macrophage fate
name: Transcriptional granulocyte commitment with suppressed monocyte-macrophage fate
rationale: All members concern transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor proliferation and granulopoiesis, and unlike the confusables the theme carries the negative regulators of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation rather than CSF receptor signalling or the erythro-megakaryocytic branch.

core: germline and early embryonic chromatin reprogramming
qualifier: imprinting, X inactivation and piRNA-directed transposon silencing
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Every member concerns heritable chromatin states set in germ cells or the zygotic pronuclei, which separates it from confusables built on maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and piRNA biogenesis per se.

core: monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism and reuptake
qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin synthesis with MAO/COMT degradation and SLC6 transport
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter biosynthesis, degradation and reuptake transport
rationale: All members handle dopamine, norepinephrine, serotonin or histamine as chemical substrate (synthesis, oxidative degradation, vesicular loading, plasma-membrane reuptake), unlike confusables about adrenergic tissue development, tetrahydrobiopterin supply or GABA transport.

core: vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
name: Vascular associated smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
rationale: Members are the bidirectional controls on vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis and de/differentiation, i.e. phenotypic switching, distinct from cardiac and skeletal muscle growth, aortic morphogenesis and endothelial or vessel-remodelling confusables.

core: endoplasmic reticulum stress and unfolded protein response
qualifier: coupled to ER protein insertion, retention and retrotranslocation
name: Unfolded protein response with ER protein insertion and retrotranslocation
rationale: All members concern folding load in the ER (and its mitochondrial counterpart) and the branches that sense or relieve it, including co- and post-translational membrane insertion and ER-to-cytosol export, which sets it apart from COPII export traffic, cytosolic chaperonin/heat-shock and FOXO confusables.

core: pancreatic progenitor lineage specification
qualifier: endocrine and neuroendocrine cell fate
name: Pancreatic progenitor lineage specification and neuroendocrine differentiation
rationale: Members are the staged transcriptional programmes that take pancreatic bud precursors to endocrine and exocrine fates plus related neuroendocrine and adrenal differentiation, not the hormone secretion, definitive endoderm or urogenital development of the confusables.

core: collagen biosynthesis and fibril organization
qualifier: regulatory control of matrix deposition
name: Regulation of collagen synthesis and fibril deposition
rationale: Each member concerns how much collagen is made and assembled into fibrils and matrix, whereas confusables cover crosslinking, elastic fibres, basement membrane and collagen degradation.

core: mitotic DNA replication initiation and synthesis
qualifier: origin licensing and polymerase/helicase activity, not checkpoint signalling
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and polymerase activity
rationale: All members concern firing origins and synthesizing DNA during the mitotic cycle, distinguishing it from confusables centred on replication-stress and intra-S checkpoints or on E2F/pre-replicative complex transcriptional control.

core: plasma membrane phospholipid externalization and lipid-mediated cell clearance
qualifier: including pulmonary surfactant lipid handling
name: Phospholipid scrambling, apoptotic cell clearance and surfactant lipid handling
rationale: Members all concern moving phospholipid between membrane leaflets or compartments and what that enables, phosphatidylserine display with engulfment of dying cells and surfactant lipid secretion and its genetic failures, unlike the alveolar cell differentiation and generic membrane-traffic confusables.

core: mucopolysaccharidoses from lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation defects
qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan, keratan and hyaluronan blocks
name: Mucopolysaccharidoses blocking chondroitin, dermatan and keratan sulfate catabolism
rationale: Every member is a mucopolysaccharidosis caused by a missing lysosomal enzyme step in glycosaminoglycan breakdown, and the theme holds the types with chondroitin/dermatan, keratan or hyaluronan blocks rather than the heparan-only Sanfilippo types or the normal degradation routes in the confusables.

core: dietary cobalamin uptake and transport
qualifier: intrinsic factor-dependent intestinal absorption
name: Dietary cobalamin absorption via intrinsic factor and transport
rationale: All three members concern getting vitamin B12 from the gut lumen into the body, which separates them from confusables on intracellular cobalamin processing and trafficking, other B vitamins and propionyl-CoA metabolism.

core: repulsive axon guidance and growth cone collapse
qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and ephrin cues
name: Semaphorin and ephrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members are semaphorin/plexin and EPH-ephrin repulsion with the cytoskeletal collapse, pruning and defasciculation they cause, unlike confusables built on netrin and SLIT-ROBO cues, generic guidance direction terms or collateral sprouting.

core: striated muscle contractile apparatus and its membrane anchoring
qualifier: costamere, T-tubule, caveolar and integrin-adhesion coupling
name: Striated muscle contraction with costameric membrane-cytoskeleton anchoring
rationale: All members concern the assembled contractile apparatus of cardiac and skeletal fibres and the junctions, rafts, T-tubules and adhesion complexes that transmit and electrically coordinate its force, not myogenic differentiation, epithelial desmosomes or SRF transcriptional targets.

core: chaperonin-mediated de novo folding of cytoskeletal and oligomeric substrates
qualifier: CCT/TriC with prefoldin, and refolding or stabilization of complexes
name: Chaperonin-mediated de novo folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: Members centre on the cytosolic chaperonin route that folds actin, tubulin and G-protein beta subunits and on the refolding, stabilization and complex assembly it supports, distinct from tubulin post-translational modification, aggrephagy and ubiquitin-proteasome degradation confusables.

core: lipoylated 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase complexes
qualifier: pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate and glycine complexes with coenzyme A supply
name: Lipoamide 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A supply
rationale: All members concern the lipoyl-dependent dehydrogenase complexes that decarboxylate pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate, 2-oxoadipate and glycine to acyl-CoA, plus the lipoylation and pantothenate/CoA supply they need, unlike the branched-chain amino acid, TCA cycle and vitamin B6 confusables.

core: cilium and flagellum axoneme assembly, trafficking and beating
qualifier: intraflagellar transport, dynein arms and motile cilia function
name: Ciliary and flagellar axoneme assembly, trafficking and beating
rationale: Every member concerns building a cilium or sperm flagellum, delivering cargo along it, or driving its motility and the fluid flow that results, unlike confusables on left/right body axis determination, tubulin modification or cilium disassembly and centriole duplication.

core: organellar lumen acidification
qualifier: sodium/proton exchanger-dependent
name: Organellar lumen acidification by sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: All members concern setting luminal pH of endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles through Na+/H+ exchange, including the SLC9A6 and SLC9A9 disease entries, rather than lysosomal V-ATPase pH control, chloride/potassium cotransport, P-type ATPases or bicarbonate exchange.

core: cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and growth
qualifier: regenerative and stress-induced growth of existing myocardium
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and regenerative growth
rationale: Members are the bidirectional controls on cardiac muscle cell number, survival and hypertrophic or regenerative growth, distinct from cardiac fibroblast and fibrosis, chamber morphogenesis, sarcomere adaptation and skeletal myogenesis confusables.

core: FGFR1 and FGFR4 proximal adaptor signalling
qualifier: beta-Klotho ligand binding with Spry and FGFRL1 inhibition
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 adaptor signalling and its inhibition
rationale: Members are the FRS- and SHC-mediated cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR4 with beta-Klotho ligand binding and the negative regulators acting on them, whereas confusables carry the FGFR2 and FGFR3 arms and the PI3K and phospholipase C branches.

core: mitochondrial ribosome assembly and translational activation
qualifier: with mitochondrial rRNA and mRNA modification
name: Mitoribosome assembly with rRNA and mRNA modification
rationale: All members concern making the mitochondrial translation apparatus competent, subunit assembly plus rRNA and mRNA modification, as opposed to confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing, mtDNA replication and transcription, or the elongation and termination steps of translation itself.

core: ERK/MAPK pathway downregulation
qualifier: dephosphorylation and negative feedback at the ERK tier
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK1/2 signalling
rationale: Members all concern switching ERK-MAPK output off, by phosphatase action, feedback loops and RSK-mediated restraint, which distinguishes them from confusables centred on RAS GAPs and RAS/RAF activating mutants.

core: canonical Wnt/beta-catenin activation by destruction complex failure
qualifier: APC and AXIN1 scaffold lesions
name: Constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signalling from destruction complex scaffold loss
rationale: The members pair the Wnt/beta-catenin transcriptional output with the scaffold lesions in APC and AXIN1 that disable the destruction complex, unlike confusables based on beta-catenin phosphosite or GSK3beta mutants and on receptor-level Wnt regulation.

core: secondary heart field and ventricular chamber formation
qualifier: cardioblast specification, septation and morphogenetic apoptosis
name: Secondary heart field specification and ventricular septum formation
rationale: All members concern early building of the ventricles and septa from secondary heart field progenitors, distinct from confusables on heart tube and pericardium morphogenesis, endocardium, and later ventricular myocardial maturation.

core: clostridial neurotoxin cleavage of SNARE proteins blocking neurotransmitter release
qualifier: serotypes C, D and G
name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotypes C, D and G blocking SNARE exocytosis
rationale: The three members are the botulinum serotype entries that cleave SNARE proteins and so stop synaptic vesicle fusion, and the qualifier separates them from the confusable holding serotypes A, B and E as well as from the normal cholinergic release and receptor confusables.

core: fibroblast and myofibroblast control in connective tissue replacement
qualifier: restraint of TGF-beta response and matrix assembly with fibroblast apoptosis
name: Myofibroblast restraint in fibrotic connective tissue replacement
rationale: Members all concern the fibroblast-to-myofibroblast conversion that replaces injured tissue with matrix and the brakes on it, unlike confusables on collagen metabolism itself, fibroblast migration, or miRNA processing.
